description: Extrude the closed regions of a sketch into a solid. op=NEW makes a body, ADD merges into existing bodies, REMOVE cuts them, INTERSECT keeps the overlap. end_type picks blind, symmetric or through-all; opposite flips the direction.

depth.description: Extrusion depth in inches; the total depth when symmetric. Required unless THROUGH_ALL or depth_variable.

depth_variable.description: Use a Part Studio variable (by name) for the depth instead.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

end_type.description: BLIND goes `depth` along the sketch normal (default); SYMMETRIC goes `depth` in total, half each side of the sketch plane; THROUGH_ALL goes past every body and ignores `depth`.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Extrude").

op.description: NEW makes a new body; ADD/REMOVE/INTERSECT combine with existing bodies (default NEW).

opposite.description: Go against the sketch normal instead of along it. Not with SYMMETRIC.

sketch.description: Feature id of the sketch to extrude.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_extrude
title: Extrude a sketch
